title: A Harbor for the Letters
author: Astrid Kavanagh
blurb: Tamsin Nakamura, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
